title: The PSP Alcohol Reset Course
official: The Alcohol Reset Course: Examining the Feasibility, Acceptability, and Effectiveness When Tailored for Public Safety Personnel
summary: This observational study evaluates an internet-delivered cognitive behavioural therapy for alcohol misuse adapted for public safety personnel (PSP), called the PSP Alcohol Reset Course. The primary objective of the study is to examine the treatment engagement, outcomes, and satisfaction of the self-guided PSP Alcohol Reset Course when offered to PSP.
